# Winch Installation and Battery Disconnects

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> **Some safety-critical values on this page are not confirmed** (marked [Unverified] or [Partial]): they come from one source or are only partly supported. Verify against the factory service manual before use; later runs re-check them against new sources.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Mount the battery disconnect near the relay box and run a cable from the positive terminal to it. [t396]

## Tools

- [Partial] Relay box lid (for mounting) [t396]

## Parts

- Anderson type connectors for positive cable disconnect [t396]
- Blue Sea M-Series Mini On-Off Battery Switch (6006200) [t396]

## Specifications

- **Heavy duty switch depth**: 3-3/8" [t396] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Heavy duty switch diameter**: 5-1/4 square inches [t396] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Switch continuous amperage (single switch)**: 140a [t396] ([Unverified] single report)

## Tips & gotchas

- Ensure the wireless dongle is unplugged from the controller to minimize phantom power draw. [t396]
- Use a switch rated for at least 300a continuous current if running high-amperage winches. [t396]
